name: Stone Seer Eilidh

intro.text: Thirteen in the ring. I counted twice. Three times. Is there one extra? Please say there isn't. I'll battle you for it.

win: The stones are older than the argument. Well done.
after: The people who raised these stones had no metal tools. They raised thirteen, a tall one, and an avenue, and they lined it up on the moon. We argue about what the stones are for. They never did.
